tei:div.tei:p: 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seng ge'i gsung 'bum 'di ni/ ris med kyi rgyal bstan spyi la lhag bsam dang dag snang mnga' ba/ gzan dkar mchog sprul thub bstan nyi mas bka' slob dang mdzub ston 'og/ lo ngo mang po'i ring ma dpe 'tshol bsdu dang legs sgrig byas pa brgyud da lan 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seng ge'i gsung 'bum deb gsum mkhyen ldan gzigs pa po rnams kyi spyan lam du 'bul rgyu yin/ spyir 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seng ge dang 'u yug pa bsod nams seng ge gnyis gang zag gcig la mtshan gny-is sam/ yang na gang zag tha dad gang yin/ snga ma ltar na 'u yug pa bsod nams seng ge'am rigs pa'i seng ge ni/ 'u shang rdor sogs su gnyal zhig 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i drung*/ phar phyin sogs gzhung lugs rnams la sbyangs pas/ gnyal zhig gi slob ma bu dgu las bar tshar gsum gyi ya gyal du 'u yug pa bsod nams seng ge zhes grags/ de rjes chos rjai sa paṇa gyi zhabs la gtugs te/ rnam 'grel dang rigs gter sogs gsan pas/ sa paṇa gyi bu chen bshad pa'i rgyun 'dzin shar nub gung gsum du grags pa las nub pa'i thog ma'i gdan sa ba mdzad cing*/ phyis chos rje hor yul du phebs skabs gdan sa chen po dpal sa skya'i 'chad nyan pa mdzad/ phyi ma ltar na 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seng ge ni/ chos rje sa paṇa gyi dngos slob tshad ma'i phyogs la shin tu mkhas pa'i rnam 'grel la bod 'grel thog mar mdzad pa po dang*/ rigs gter la'ang gzhan 'grel gyi srol gtod pa po'i mkhas dbang zhig ste/ rnam 'grel dang rigs gter gyi rgyun 'dzin gtso bo zhig yin par mngon/mdor na 'u yug pa bsod nams seng ge zhes pa'i mtshan dang mdzad rjes thor re tsam ni/ deb sngon/ deb dmar/ yig tshang mkhas pa dga' byed sogs chos 'byung dang lo rgyus dag la gsal zhing*/ 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seng ge ni nyid kyi rnam 'grel gyi rnam bshad dang*/

rigs gter dgongs 'grel gyi mdzad byang dang*/ gzhan tshad ma'i skor gyi gzhung kha cig dang*/ mang thos klu sgrub pa'i bstan rtsis/ ngag sgros las byung bar/ 'u yug pa rigs pa'i seng ge sngon gsang phu ba'i dge bshes yin par chos rje sa paṇa gyi mdun rtsod pa'i phyir sa skyar phebs/ skabs der chos rjes slob tshogs mang po la chos gsung bzhin par yang rtsod du brtsams te 'ong bar/ chos rje'i zhal nas/ ston pa khur phobs cung ngal gsos zhes gsung par khong yang chos thun de'i ring chos gral bzhugs pas chos rje'i legs bshad kyis yid 'phrog / mi phyed pa'i dad pa thob nas/ chos rje'i zhabs la gtugs/ phyis rgyud 'dzin gtso bo zhig byung zhes grag go / des na bod ston dag la mtshan gyi rnam grangs mang ba/ khong gnyis 'khrungs yul dang*/ dus rabs/ bla ma/ mdzad rjes bcas gcig par brten nas slob dpon gcig nyid du ngos bzung nas rnam thar dang gsung 'bum bsgrig rgyu las/ da lan bstan bcos tshad ma rigs pa'i gter gyi rgyan rigs pa grub pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ tshig 'grel dang*/ don 'grel gnyis las don 'grel du snang zhing*/ nang don yang rigs gter rtsa ba las rab byed dam le'u'i go rim dkrugs pa ma zad/ yul brtag pa'i rab byed gcig nyid la'ang yul gyi ngo bo dpyad pa'i le'u dang*/ yul gyi khyad par dpyad pa'i le'u zhes so sor phyes pa dang*/ blo brtag pa'i rab byed dang*/ spyi dang bye brag brtag pa/ sgrub pa dang gzhan sel brtag pa/ brjod bya dang rjod byed brtag pa/ 'brel ba brtag pa/ 'gal ba brtag pa bcas rab byed drug/ blo spyi'i rnam gzhag dpyad pa'i le'u zhes gcig tu bsdus shing*/ gzhan yang tshad ma spyi'i rnam bzhag dpyad pa'i le'u zhes logs su bkod pa| mngon sum dang*/ rang don rjes dpag / gzhan don rjes dpag bcas le'u gsum 'dra ba las/ yang mtshan nyid brtag pa'i le'u mjug tu phud pa bcas chos rje nyid kyi gsung gi bdud rtsi dngos su myangs pa'i mkhas pa chen po zhig gis 'di ltar dbye bsdu mdzad pa la dgos pa dang go don khyad pa can yod pa ni gdon mi za'o/

/ ldong ston chen po'i rigs pa'i snang ba dang gzhung rnying pa rnams la rab byed bcu gsum bzhugs pa yang*/ klo bo mkhan po'i rigs gter 'grel pa las/ 'di dang po brtsom gzhi lta bur mdzad do zhes yid ches pa'i bla ma dag gi gsung las thos so zhes bshad pas/ 'di yang de bzhin nam yang na go don gzhan zhig yod nges pas blo ldan dag gis dpyad par zhu'o/ / da lan 'di 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang dpe rtags ( phyi zha31 ) nang bzhugs rigs pa grub pa zhes pa 'di nged dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang gis bsdu sgrig zhus te/ mes po'i shul bzhag ces pa'i dpe tshogs kyi khongs su spar bskrun zhus pa yin/ las gzhi 'di'i ma dpe 'tshol bsdu dang dpe sgrig 'gan 'dzin karma bde legs/ rtsis 'khor nang du blugs pa'i 'gan khur ba mkhan po 'gro 'dul rdo rje/ ma dpe mkho 'don mdzad mkhan dpal gyi 'bras spungs chos sde/ chos sde chen po ngor e waṃ bshad grwa'i mkhan po thub bstan snying po/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe mdzod khang bcas dang*/ zhus dag thad rigs pa grub pa ni 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang dpe rtags ( phyi zha 31 ) nang bzhugs las/ phrad sbyor stangs dang*/ mngon gsal yig nor kha shas brda sprod ltar dang*/ tshig 'bru mi gsal ba mi nyung ba tsam zhig rang 'grel sogs/ rigs gter gyi 'grel pa mang po zhig la gtugs nas zhus yod/ tshad ma rnam 'grel gyi bsdus don rigs pa'i sdom ni/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang dpe rtags ( phyi zha 6 ) nang bzhugs dang*/ sde spar gnyis las/ snga ma ni ches dpe rnying gi dbang gis tshig 'bru mi gsal ba dang*/ rtsa ba nas mi mthong ba kha shas 'dug pa dag /gtso bo sde spar la khungs gtugs yod/ rigs mdzod ni/ 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang dpe rtags ( phyi zha 32 ) nang bzhugs dang*/ sde dge'i spar ma/ sku 'bum spar ma bcas gsum las gtso bo 'bras spungs gnas bcu lha khang nang bzhugs kyi dpe rnying la khungs bcol nas bzhag yod/

de las ches dpe rnying gi dbang gis tshig 'bru mi gsal ba dang*/ rtsa chad song rigs dang phrad sbyor stangs/ mngon gsal yig nor dag sde spar ltar bcos yod/ zhu dag spyi'i brda gsar rnying sogs la grogs dan pa bstan 'dzin blo gros dang*/ rtsis 'khor nang blug mkhan dpal brtsegs las zhor slob ma rnams dang*/ deb sgrig pa shes rab dpal g.yang dang*/ tshe ring chos sgron gnyis kyis bgyis te grub pa zhig yin/ mjug tu ngas las gzhi 'di'i ma dpe 'tshol bsdu ba'i tshab zhus te/ gong gsal gyi dpe khag gsum g.yar gnang mdzad mkhan/ 'bras spungs chos sde/ ngor bshad grwa'i mkhan po thub bstan snying po dang*/ bod ljongs dpe mdzod khang gi las bzo ba yongs la thugs rje che zhu/ zhes dpal brtsegs bod yig dpe rnying zhib 'jug khang nas thub bstan nyi mas so/ / / / bsdu sgrig gsal bshad/ PAGE -PAGE 5--PAGE 1-
